text:
Which statement describes a homologous series?
A
a family of elements in the same group of the Periodic Table
B
a family of elements with similar chemical properties
C
a family of compounds with the same functional group
D
a family of compounds with similar physical properties

options.label: A
options.text: a family of elements in the same group of the Periodic Table

options.label: B
options.text: a family of elements with similar chemical properties

options.label: C
options.text: a family of compounds with the same functional group

options.label: D
options.text: a family of compounds with similar physical properties
